title: AF-CALVADOS: AlphaFold-guided simulations of multi-domain proteins at the proteome level.
authors: von Bulow, Soren; Johansson, Kristoffer E; Lindorff-Larsen, Kresten
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
one_liner_zh: 该文开发了AlphaFold引导的粗粒化模拟模型AF-CALVADOS，用于多域蛋白和固有无序蛋白的动态模拟，并应用于人类转录因子分析，虽非直接TF-DNA结合建模，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Deep-learning methods have transformed our ability to predict the three-dimensional structures of folded proteins from sequence, and coarse-grained simulations have made it possible to study intrinsically disordered proteins at the proteome scale. More than half of human proteins, however, contain mixtures of disordered regions and one or more folded domains, and the biological function of these multi-domain proteins (MDPs) depends on the interplay between the folded and disordered regions. Here, we developed AF-CALVADOS, a coarse-grained simulation model that is informed by AlphaFold to model the dynamics of intrinsically disordered proteins and MDPs containing mixtures of folded and disordered regions. AF-CALVADOS leverages information from AlphaFold 2 to model folded regions that we then integrate with the coarse-grained CALVADOS model. Our automated framework makes it possible to perform simulations of any soluble folded or disordered protein without manually defining the folded regions, enabling scaling to the proteome level. We validate AF-CALVADOS using experimental small-angle x-ray scattering data for more than 400 proteins and find that it performs well across proteins with varying amounts of ordered and disordered regions. We demonstrate the scalability of AF-CALVADOS by performing simulations of 12,483 intracellular human proteins and make the data freely available; we envisage that large-scale simulation data generated by AF-CALVADOS can be used to benchmark or train machine learning models for flexible, MDPs. The conformational ensembles can also be used to study sequence-dynamics-function relationships at scale, and can shed light on the interplay between folded and disordered regions. We illustrate this by analyzing the disordered regions in 1487 human transcription factors. AF-CALVADOS is available as part of the CALVADOS package at: github.com/KULL-Centre/CALVADOS. Single-chain simulations with AF-CALVADOS can be run via Google Colab: colab.research.google.com/github/KULL-Centre/_2025_buelow_AF-CALVADOS/blob/main/AF_CALVADOS.ipynb.
abstract_zh: 深度学习方法已经改变了我们从序列预测折叠蛋白三维结构的能力，而粗粒化模拟使得在蛋白质组规模上研究固有无序蛋白成为可能。然而，超过一半的人类蛋白质包含无序区域与一个或多个折叠结构域的混合物，这些多结构域蛋白（MDPs）的生物学功能取决于折叠区域与无序区域之间的相互作用。在此，我们开发了AF-CALVADOS，一种由AlphaFold提供信息的粗粒化模拟模型，用于模拟固有无序蛋白以及包含折叠和无序区域混合物的MDPs的动态。AF-CALVADOS利用AlphaFold 2的信息来建模折叠区域，然后将其与粗粒化CALVADOS模型集成。我们的自动化框架使得无需手动定义折叠区域即可对任何可溶性折叠或无序蛋白进行模拟，从而实现蛋白质组水平的扩展。我们使用超过400种蛋白质的实验小角X射线散射数据验证了AF-CALVADOS，并发现它在具有不同有序和无序区域比例的蛋白质中表现良好。我们通过对12,483种细胞内人类蛋白质进行模拟来展示AF-CALVADOS的可扩展性，并免费提供这些数据；我们设想，AF-CALVADOS生成的大规模模拟数据可用于基准测试或训练针对柔性MDPs的机器学习模型。构象系综还可用于研究序列-动力学-功能关系在规模上的应用，并有助于阐明折叠区域与无序区域之间的相互作用。我们通过分析1,487种人类转录因子中的无序区域来示例说明这一点。AF-CALVADOS作为CALVADOS包的一部分可在以下网址获取：github.com/KULL-Centre/CALVADOS。使用AF-CALVADOS的单链模拟可通过Google Colab运行：colab.research.google.com/github/KULL-Centre/_2025_buelow_AF-CALVADOS/blob/main/AF_CALVADOS.ipynb。
